channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Troy Murphy | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Troy Murphy from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Corey Maggette on Troy Murphy
item.description:
Evans Clinchy:Maggette:

“No one on our team can shoot tonight, so I'm just gonna run into Troy Murphy as hard as possible and get a whistle.”

Corey Maggette on Troy Murphy, Mar 14, 2011. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Avery Johnson on Troy Murphy, Billy King
item.description:
Relaying a message from GM Billy King, Johnson said Wednesday that he expects all his players to remain with the club past Feb. 24.Only Troy Murphy, who requested a trade and has not been with the team since last month, is on Johnson’s departure radar.

“I know Billy (King) is hoping to do something with Murphy and I hope that happens because Murphy’s a good kid and it hadn’t worked out here,”

Avery Johnson on Troy Murphy, Billy King, Feb 18, 2011. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Avery Johnson on Troy Murphy
item.description:
“I think that’ll be the only thing of what we get back in a trade or in a situation with Murphy.”

Avery Johnson on Troy Murphy, Feb 18, 2011. Source: New York Daily News.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Troy Murphy
item.description:
“Teams are calling the Nets and saying, ‘Are you going to buy out Troy Murphy?’ … That’s just the way it works. That’s how you get what they call divorce contracts, because if he doesn’t know where he’s going to go, he doesn’t know how to do the buyout.”

Mark Cuban on Troy Murphy, Jan 23, 2011. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: Avery Johnson on Troy Murphy
item.description:
The next step for Murphy will be to participate in a minimum of three full practices with the team before he could possibly be ready to play in a game, Johnson said.

“I would say a minimum three (practices), because he hasn’t really practiced,'' Johnson said of Murphy, the Sparta native who has missed all of training camp and the preseason with a back problem.”

Avery Johnson on Troy Murphy, Oct 26, 2010. Source: Newark Star-Ledger.
